name_input: SEVEN STAR FRUITS PVT LTD; SEVEN STAR FRUITS PVT LTD; SEVEN STAR FRUITS PVT LTD; SEVEN STAR FRUITS PVT LTD; SEVEN STAR FRUITS PRIVATE LIMITED; SEVEN STAR FRUITS PVT LTD
export_evidence: No export shipment record found. The only customs records retrieved for this entity are INBOUND (imports into India). Exact line from importkey.com/countries/india/seven-star-fruits-private-limited: "2026-02-24 | SORVISE SRL. | SEVEN STAR FRUITS PRIVATE LIMITED | LIVE APPLE PLANTS APPLE SAPLINGS M9 T337 9-11 (LIVE PLANTS FOR PLANTING PURPOSE) | VENICE, ITALY | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 06022090 | 7716743" — origin Italy, destination India, i.e. an import, not an export. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 74 Records detected"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (dates 2026-02-24, 2026-02-11, 2025-08-16, 2025-05-09, 2025-05-05). All 5 visible rows run Europe -> India. No outbound B/L, no foreign destination, no export HS line was observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. The only India-side activity evidenced is the company acting as importer of record at Indian ports (Delhi Air Cargo, Sonepat ICD, Bombay Air Cargo) — that proves customs presence in India, not domestic supply to Indian buyers. ImportKey's 'Buyers' block lists foreign buyers (UNITED FRUITS B.V. Netherlands, FRUCHTHANSA GMBH Germany, DOLE EUROPE GMBH Germany) but these are aggregated counterparty lists across many Indian exporters, not records attributable to this company's own outbound shipments. No domestic supply record confirmed.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the declared HS 060220 (live plants/saplings) is factually correct for this company's actual trade, but the trade is IMPORT, not export. The company imports live apple and blueberry saplings (Malus domestica, PLABLUE 1549) from Italian, Belgian, Spanish, French and Dutch nurseries for planting purposes — it is an importer/plantation operator, not an exporter of food/FMCG goods. The claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a mischaracterisation: this is horticulture/nursery planting material, not food products. Registered address per ImportKey: RESHAM BHAWAN, 2ND FLOOR, 78, VEER NARIMAN ROAD, CHURCHGATE, Mumbai — consistent with claimed Maharashtra state. Per Rule 5: no export shipments found and no confirmed domestic supply records found; следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено, следов внутренних поставок не найдено. Per Rule 3, HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection — the company stays in the database with the factual HS 06022090 (import side) recorded. Caveats: (1) the free ImportKey view exposes only 5 of 74 claimed rows, so the remaining 69 rows are unverified and could in principle contain export lines; (2) volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius all returned HTTP 403 and the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend was unreachable (connection refused), so no second source could corroborate; (3) revenue, export volume, GST turnover and CIN/PAN were not publicly retrievable — recorded as null, not estimated. PAN AAECS9271N was not independently verified against any public record.
